params.prompt: Create a 1:1 clean DTC commercial storyboard grid for Scene 1 of "SOLARA SPF Ritual" - 2x2 layout, exactly 4 panels on a clean black canvas, panels separated by thin black gutters only. Overarching scene theme: a premium mineral sunscreen ritual on a bathroom stone ledge, consistent soft daylight, accurate white 50ml squeeze tube, matte coral cap, and exact readable label "SOLARA SPF 50 PA++++" with small line "mineral sunscreen"; no extra claims, no badges, no awards, no reef safe, no SPF 70, no dermatologist language. Panels left-to-right top-to-bottom: Panel 1 product tube standing upright with water beads around the cap. Panel 2 a fingertip dispenses a clean white ribbon of sunscreen beside the tube. Panel 3 tube lies diagonally on stone, label squarely readable, coral cap catching light. Panel 4 final product hero with tube centered, cap forward, label sharp and unaltered. Environment: bathroom stone ledge, midday, clear. Mood: hopeful. Visual style: clean DTC commercial photography, accurate product colors, premium skincare brand polish, Sony FX3, 35mm prime lens, soft natural daylight, shallow depth of field. Below each panel: narrow black caption band with panel number, time code, and two caption sentences. Forbidden: no title banner, no footer, no colored gridlines, no director notes, no invented label copy. Render at 1:1 aspect ratio, 1K, medium quality.
